messages:
Maria: heads-up — GitOps sweep found drift in prod-us-west1 nodepool autoscaler. Terraform desired_count is 6, actual nodes show 4. This is causing GPU shortages for batch jobs. https://git.internal/runs/3421
Devon: looking at autoscaler logs — scale-up failing with quota error: 'Insufficient accelerators in region'
Aj: which accelerator type? A100?
Devon: yep, A100. Project quota is 8, current usage 8, plan wants +2 to satisfy desired_count.
Maria: OPA also flagged this change — policy 'nodepool-size-review' requires manual approval for >10 or quota-exceeding changes. PR #2345 merged last night touched module.
infra-bot: drift-detector alert: id=drift-20260315-09; repo=infra/terraform; terraform_diff: desired_count: 4 -> 6; severity=high; suggestion=create-revert-pr OR manual-reconcile
Samantha: I opened a revert PR: https://git.internal/infra/PR6789 to revert the nodepool bump. However, we can also temporarily route pods to the dedicated pool — there are 2 idle P4s in redwood-dedicated-us-west1.
Aj: routing to dedicated pool needs nodeSelector/affinity updates in Helm; that might add latency for prod inference if model replicas move.
Devon: other option is to request a quota increase from cloud team but that can take 24-72h. We need a fast mitigation.
Maria: proposed plan: 1) apply a canary nodepool increase in one AZ via terraform 2) pin a subset of replicas to canary nodes using a Helm canary rollout 3) if stable, merge revert PR to main 4) file quota increase + OPA exception ticket
Aj: I'll create a canary TF PR and mark it for manual apply. PR #6790.
Devon: commands I'll run locally: `git checkout -b fix/nodepool-canary`
Devon: `terragrunt plan -var='desired_count=5'` then `terragrunt apply --auto-approve` once we have oncall OK
Maria: hold auto-approve until oncall signs off. @oncall can you review plan? Note cost delta: +1 A100 ~= $400/day.
oncall: give me 15m, will review the terraform plan and OPA implication.
infra-bot: reconcile job queued by Aj: job_id=rec-8801; dry_run=false
oncall: approved. Aj, you have sign-off to apply the canary. Monitor prometheus: node_gpu_util and inference_latency dashboards.
Samantha: PR merged, terraform apply started by Aj.
infra-bot: terraform apply complete — status=success; new nodepool desired_count=5; nodes registering.
Devon: nodes Ready, GPUs attached, pods scheduled. Observed initial latency bump of +12ms on small subset, within SLO.
Maria: leaving canary up for 2 hours then promote if no regressions. Also let's add a GitOps gate: block automatic apply when OPA policy exception is present and require reviewer tag.
Aj: creating follow-up issue INFRA-1123 with checklist: add pipeline gate, document OPA exception workflow, cloud quota runbook.
Samantha: posted cost impact to #finance: estimated $1.2k/week if sustained.
Maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
Devon: closing loop — revert PR remains ready if we see issues.
infra-bot: closing alert drift-20260315-09; resolution=canary-applied
Maria: marking thread resolved on my side.
